text: DSH OAuth Adapter 为 DSH Web 和桌面客户端提供 OAuth 账户与模型管理。它通过 DSH Authorization Service 接入 pi-ai 提供商登录流程，支持浏览器回调、设备码和交互式授权。用户可查看账户、同步可用模型、手动添加或编辑模型，也可断开账户。适合希望在 DSH 使用 OAuth 模型账户的用户；模型发现会访问相应提供商。

DSH OAuth Adapter brings supported pi-ai OAuth sign-in to DSH Web and desktop. Through DSH Authorization Service, users can connect accounts, view and sync available models, and add or edit models manually. It requires an account with a supported provider; model discovery contacts that provider.

An OAuth account page for the DSH Web profile. It supports:

@edge-sky/dsh-oauth-adapter README · dsh-oauth-adapter：| Provider | pi-ai sign-in path |
| --- | --- |
| OpenAI Codex | Browser callback or device code |
| GitHub Copilot | GitHub or GitHub Enterprise device code |
| Anthropic | Browser callback with manual code/redirect fallback |
| Kimi For Coding | Device code |
| OpenRouter | Browser PKCE callback |
| xAI | Device code |

@edge-sky/dsh-oauth-adapter README · dsh-oauth-adapter：The current plugin declares DSH peer compatibility as `>=0.2.0-rc.2`, with no upper version limit. Development dependencies remain pinned to `0.2.0-rc.2` to verify the minimum supported version.

@edge-sky/dsh-oauth-adapter README · Install：For DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2`: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @edge-sky/dsh-oauth-adapter ``` Or for the official desktop, use `@edge-sky/dsh-oauth-adapter` For DSH `0.1.2-rc.1` through `0.1.5-rc.1`, use an adapter release from the `0.1.3` series. For DSH `0.1.1-rc.2`, use `@edge-sky/dsh-oauth-adapter@0.1.2-rc.0`. Start DSH: ```sh npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web ```

@edge-sky/dsh-oauth-adapter README · How it works：DSH integrates pi-ai through the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` adapter, but does not provide an OAuth entry point. `@edge-sky/dsh-oauth-adapter` exposes pi-ai's existing provider login flows through the DSH Authorization Service. Browser links, device codes, text and secret input, method selection, cancellation, and withdrawn prompts all use the same provider-neutral transport.

The profile patch mounts an authorization fallback when the host does not provide `ctx.authorization`.

@edge-sky/dsh-oauth-adapter README · How it works：DSH owns OAuth credentials and login state. This adapter stores model configuration in `dsh-oauth-adapter.modelStore`; see [model migration and recovery](docs/oauth-models.md).
